It works for me, and CRAN indicates that qtl ver 1.26-14 passes all checks:

http://cran.r-project.org/web/checks/check_results_qtl.html

In R 3.0, all packages need to be re-installed.

If others are having problems, please let me know. Ideally grab the error message.

karl
